decisions.reason: After another year without clear signs of underperformance, this low-complexity care add-on likely meets modest aspiration levels through cross-selling and remains easy to carry within the firm's organisational slack.

The maintenance oil line still fits the established floor-care system well, and absent evidence of a sustained shortfall against aspirations, boundedly rational management would retain it while exploiting complementarities with core flooring sales.

This product remains somewhat more niche because it serves oiled floors specifically, but surviving its initial market period suggests performance is not far enough below aspiration to justify withdrawal yet.

Although the withdrawal of another underlay product prompts comparison within the accessory range, this moisture-protection underlay appears to be the stronger complement to installation quality and so is more likely to be kept than dropped.

The oak parquet line is closest to the firm's core capabilities, sales logic, and innovation path, so continued retention is most likely unless new evidence shows a persistent failure to meet aspiration levels.
